announcements.title: Dehradun's only one of a kind fitness box
announcements.body: Not a gym. A community. CrossFit, calisthenics, gymnastics, lifts, jumps, runs, and too much fun. Walk in, say hi, train with us.

announcements.title: Kids gymnastics is open
announcements.body: We make kids strong, flexible, and actually active. A coached hour that builds the foundation and points them in the right direction. Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, and Friday, 6:00 to 7:00 PM.

announcements.title: Saturday morning batches
announcements.body: Two sessions: 8:00 AM and 9:00 AM. Same coached class, weekend pace.

announcements.title: First class is a conversation
announcements.body: Call or WhatsApp before you come if you like, or walk in. Tell the coach what you have been doing and we scale from there.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: To ignite the warrior spirit within every individual. We are here to inspire, transform, and empower our community through fitness. Whether it is your first step or your next personal best, we give you the tools, support, and motivation to train hard, stay strong, and rise every day. Your body is your battlefield, and we train to win.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.body: To create a vibrant community where fitness enthusiasts come together to inspire and motivate one another. We aim to provide expert coaching and programs for every fitness level, and to make training accessible, enjoyable, and sustainable. Together we help people reach their personal fitness goals and keep a lifelong love of movement.
